meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. Why does my son have a zero?
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
"Cheated." My son doesn't lie, Hale, and I'm writing that word down. What exactly do you have, and why did nobody call me before that zero went into the gradebook?
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.
It's not my job to explain your document. Put it in front of me, and I'll read the times myself. You said "pasted," and I want to know whether the file says that or whether that's your word.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.
You haven't answered my question about the file, so I'll ask again later. What is the line, word for word, and where in the essay does it appear? I want to see it on the page.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.

I'm not defending him, Hale, I'm asking for evidence, and you keep giving me adjectives. My son doesn't lie, and "he lied to you" is a sentence I'll be repeating to the principal. Show me the essay and the file, or I'm going upstairs.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

"Take it or leave it" isn't in your procedure, Hale. I printed it: 4.2 says you call me before any mark goes in, and you didn't. The zero comes out of the gradebook today while we talk, and I'm still waiting to see a single document.
I'm waiting, Hale. You asked for this meeting, and so far I've heard accusations and no paper. Turn the screen around.
